recent: Deleum 于 2026 年 10 月宣布以 RM13 million 将旗下科技解决方案子公司 86% 股权出售给 Ocean Vantage；此前公司于 8 月宣派每股 3.50 sen 的首次中期股息，并公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩。
notable: 宣派首次中期单层股息每股 3.50 sen。
公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩。

recent_en: In October 2026, Deleum announced the disposal of an 86% stake in its technology solutions unit to Ocean Vantage for RM13 million. Earlier, in August, the company declared a first interim dividend of 3.50 sen per share and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of an 86% stake in its technology solutions unit to Ocean Vantage for RM13 million.
Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 3.50 sen per share.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: An announcement was made under the category of winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator; details were not provided.
earnings_en: For Q2 2026, revenue was MYR 191.486 million, up 3.5% QoQ but down 19.2% YoY; net income was MYR 10.336 million, up 15.4% QoQ but down 47.2% YoY; net margin was 5.4%, up from 4.8% in the previous quarter.
